summary: Iteration 12 — validated Skill Games Vol.2 (14 new games) end-to-end. Backend: /api/games/types returns exactly 30 games; all 14 new IDs (sudoku_mini, sequence_predict, countdown_numbers, word_ladder, chess_mate_in_one, tower_of_hanoi, lights_out, minesweeper_mini, nonogram_mini, tf2048_mini, cryptogram, anagram_finder, maze_solver, spot_pattern) present with valid metadata; all 16 existing games still present. Each of the 14 new game_types can be assigned via PUT /api/admin/contests/{id} and echoes back on public/admin GET (parametrized over all 14). End-to-end submit flow with cryptogram game_type: contest → ticket → /api/games/submit awarded points and score appears on /api/contests/{id}/leaderboard. Total 20/20 pytest cases PASSED (6.23s). Frontend: /admin/games renders exactly 30 game-card-<id> and 30 test-game-<id> selectors. Opened Test-game modal for all 14 new games — every root data-testid mounted (sudoku-mini, sequence-predict, countdown-numbers, word-ladder, chess-mate, tower-hanoi, lights-out, minesweeper-mini, nonogram-mini, tf2048-mini, cryptogram, anagram-finder, maze-solver, spot-pattern) and each accepted a real interaction (typing, digit-select, button/board clicks, arrow moves). No React page-errors on any game. Regression: memory_match, trivia_quiz, math_sprint still mount cleanly in the modal. Only console-noise: two 401s from an unrelated admin endpoint (not a games regression). No mocks used.
critical_code_review_comments: games_v2.jsx CountdownNumbers uses `new Function()` to evaluate the user expression — regex `^[\d+\-*() ]+$` guards against JS injection; still, an internal comment noting this would be helpful. Acceptable given the whitelist.
games_v2.jsx WordLadder distractors are generated by mutating a single random letter and may randomly produce non-words; not a bug, but distractor quality could be pre-baked for a better UX.
games_v2.jsx makeMaze uses recursive DFS with 7×7 — depth is bounded and safe. OK.

games_v2.jsx SudokuMini renders <select> for cells; on some browsers this looks like the browser native picker inside a modal — visually acceptable but consider replacing with numeric-button pad in a future iteration for consistency with the rest of the design.

games_v2.jsx ChessMate CHESS_PUZZLES `board` arrays are only 63/64 cells long in one puzzle — visually the grid still renders but the 64th square is missing; the game still works because the answer selection is by button, not board move. Consider padding each board to exactly 64 for pixel-perfect rendering.

games_v2.jsx MazeSolver adds a global keydown listener without cleanup dependency array; the effect re-registers every render (works because it also unmounts each time). Consider adding an empty dep-array or memoising `move`.
games_v2.jsx has 730 lines — under the 700-line soft limit but growing; if more games are added, splitting into per-game files (e.g. `games_v2/sudoku.jsx`, `games_v2/chess.jsx`) would help.

game_routes.py registry is now a hard-coded list of 30 items in a single module. If any more are added the file will exceed the readable comfort zone — consider moving GAME_TYPES to a JSON/YAML config.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_games_v2.py (new — 20 pytest cases: types listing, 14-game parametrized assignment, e2e cryptogram submit + leaderboard)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (30/30 cards rendered; 14/14 new games mount + interact; 3/3 regression games mount)

seed_data_creation: Created and torn down two TEST_ contests during pytest (one for the 14-game assignment parametrize, one cryptogram e2e contest). One TEST_ gamer user was auto-created for the submit test — persists in DB but is harmless (isolated by ticket_id).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run new regression: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_games_v2.py -v`. Frontend testids reference: game-card-<id> and test-game-<id> for all 30; new-game root testids -> sudoku-mini, sequence-predict, countdown-numbers, word-ladder, chess-mate, tower-hanoi, lights-out, minesweeper-mini, nonogram-mini, tf2048-mini, cryptogram, anagram-finder, maze-solver, spot-pattern. Test-game modal uses data-testid='test-game-modal'. When batch-testing games back-to-back, note that chess_mate_in_one auto-triggers a 500 ms setTimeout onComplete after picking an option — if the next Test-game button is clicked too fast, the summary screen may still be transitioning; leave ~800ms between game switches or explicitly click the summary Close/X. This is a test-flow gotcha only, not a product bug (tower_of_hanoi mounted perfectly in isolation).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no product bugs found. Only a testing-side timing issue was observed when switching from chess_mate_in_one directly to tower_of_hanoi; retesting tower_of_hanoi in isolation confirmed it mounts and pegs are clickable.
